answer.rationale: Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: the recovered source contradicts memory_73, showing that a 40% SMB discount lifted acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%. Signup simplification is the strongest verified alternative for this segment, producing activation and qualified-revenue gains with only a 1% retention decline. Run an SMB-scoped experiment rather than generalizing beyond the replicated segment; this may improve acquisition economics but is not assumed to solve churn among existing accounts.
